sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No verified candidate: the scoped vocabulary lacks canonical controlled tank-type values and verified cross-owner tank-specific paths needed to preserve entity pairing.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the constraint so every qualifying tank is evaluated as the same tank entity: use the supplied tankType applicability term (with its controlled oil-residue and oily-bilge-water values or the verified canonical representation) rather than substituting rdf:type checks, and pair that tank's individual capacity with its outer-shell separation. Do not join capacity or separation as unrelated ship-level facts or test for one separation anywhere on the ship; the current NOT EXISTS therefore permits accidental passes and targets the wrong relationship.
